About Rogers Transport
All you have to do is call us with your freight requirements and one of our friendly and experienced controllers will look after everything for you.
Services include General haulage on nationwide or international journeys, specialised transport, events haulage and pallet distrubition .
With our well maintained modern euro 5/6 vehicles we can undertake any freight any load any where any when.
All of our vehicles have tail lifts with powered pump trucks or for heavier lifting we can supply mounted forklifts.
What we need to know from you
It is helpful if you can have the following information to hand when you call.
1. Number of pieces
2. Weights and dimensions (Please specify if dimensions are metric or imperial, e.g. inches or cm).
3. When and where we are collecting from and delivering to (including postcodes)
4. Is the freight ready for collection?
5. Are customs and airline handling complete (if applicable)?
6. Is the freight hazardous?
7. Your reference number
Our drivers are Level D security trained for Air freight transportation. With knowledge of Heathrow, Gatwick, Stanstead, Manchester and Prestwick Airports.
We pride ourselves on prompt collections and deliveries for time critical freight.
With the ability to double man a vehicle we can easily deliver your freight quicker than most competitors.
We can move one pallet or 29 tonnes of corn or even an oversized aeroplane.
